items.title: Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts
items.summary: Coinkite published its full Coldcard postmortem, saying a five-year firmware flaw weakened wallet seeds and that about 242 customer accounts have reported losses. This post Coldcard Postmortem Says Weak Seeds, Not Hacked Devices, Drove Bitcoin Thefts first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
